dashboard_period: Since launch · dashboard view: Last 1 Year

kpi_note.title: A new view of booking demand
kpi_note.text: Booking Opportunities Captured was introduced in the last week of July, so 109 is a partial-period baseline rather than a since-launch total. It counts calls where someone expressed an intent to book, play or reserve and SpeakSport took the correct next action—sending the booking link or transferring the caller to staff.

highlights.title: A booking request became an immediate online path
highlights.summary: A caller looking for an August tee time chose the digital route. SpeakSport explained the online-booking option for reservations within 30 days and sent the tee-sheet link directly to the caller’s phone.
highlights.quote: “Would you like me to transfer you to the golf shop or text you the link to the online tee sheet?” The caller chose the link, and SpeakSport confirmed it was sent.

highlights.title: A booking-intent caller reached staff by preference
highlights.summary: When a caller wanted to schedule a tee time for 20 August and preferred personal help over the online route, SpeakSport gave the choice clearly and transferred the call to the golf shop.
highlights.quote: “Transfer me to the golf shop, please.” SpeakSport responded: “Transferring you to the golf shop.”

highlights.title: Practice-facility availability was resolved without a transfer
highlights.summary: A caller received a complete answer about seasonal and in-season practice-facility access, including the operating days and hours for the range, chipping and putting areas.
highlights.quote: “During the golf season, the driving range and practice facilities, including the chipping and putting areas, are open daily from 7:30 AM to 5:00 PM.”

features_intro: For Paako Ridge, we have focused recent improvements on capturing booking demand reliably, giving callers the right online path and making each hand-off easier to understand.

features.title: Booking-opportunity tracking
features.description: The new KPI makes previously invisible booking demand measurable, including both text-link delivery and appropriate transfers to staff.

features.title: Stronger booking-intent recognition
features.description: SpeakSport is better able to recognise when a caller wants to book, reserve or play—even when speech recognition turns “tee time” into something less obvious.

features.title: Clearer online-booking hand-off
features.description: Standard booking callers can receive the direct link by text, while exceptions and callers who need human help are routed to the golf shop.

features.title: Richer back-office reporting
features.description: The dashboard now supports filtering calls by intent, category and outcome, making demand patterns and operational opportunities easier to find.

future_note: We will continue enriching SpeakSport with capabilities such as self-serve knowledge-base updates and even better reporting. We would love Paako Ridge to remain part of that journey—please keep sharing feedback, ideas and initiatives you would like us to explore.

future_priorities.title: Self-serve knowledge base
future_priorities.description: Make it easier for your team to keep answers, hours and operating information current.

future_priorities.title: Even better reporting
future_priorities.description: Add clearer views of booking demand, link delivery, hand-offs and caller outcomes.
